Strategy: Tune the winning band slightly: reward leftovers between twenty-six and forty, penalize leftovers between five and eighteen, keeping the shape that just beat Best Fit. It may help by refining the edges, but may fail if the improvement came from the earlier exact edges.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (25 if r - item >= 26 and r - item <= 40 else 0) - (30 if r - item >= 5 and r - item <= 18 else 0) for r in bins]
```
